items.title: Aid room supplies and patroller readiness
items.text: Each aid room and top shack keeps its own supply levels, with reorder points, and one morning board adds patrollers whose certifications are due, next to the kits that are not ready.

items.title: Keep selling when the internet drops
items.text: The ticket window keeps selling cash and card-reader sales if the lodge loses its connection, and catches everything up as soon as it is back.

items.title: Bring your data with you
items.text: Upload what your old system or spreadsheets export, such as customers, pass holders, products, staff and the rental fleet. Verdynt/OS matches the columns, flags duplicates and problems, and shows you a preview before anything is saved.

items.title: Sales into QuickBooks Online
items.text: Each day's sales, refunds and payments go to QuickBooks Online instead of being typed in.

items.title: Reload a card online, straight to the lift
items.text: Guests with a lift card buy their day online and go straight to the lift, without stopping at the window.

items.title: Season pass payment plans
items.text: Sell a pass with a deposit and monthly payments, taken automatically.

items.title: Tickets in Apple and Google Wallet
items.text: Guests add their ticket or pass to their phone's wallet and scan it at the lift.

items.title: Café and retail sales from Square or Toast
items.text: Food, drink and shop sales from Square or Toast appear in Money next to tickets and lessons, so the day adds up in one place.

items.title: This season against last
items.text: Visits, sales, lessons and incidents side by side with the same day last season.

items.title: Partner passes
items.text: Record Indy Pass and reciprocal pass visits at the window and see them in your reports.

items.title: Snowmaking log
items.text: Which guns ran on which trails, for how long, with the water used and the conditions, so you can see what each foot of snow cost.

items.title: Hiring seasonal staff
items.text: An application form, then the paperwork and checklist for each new hire, before their first shift.

items.title: Season-end survey help
items.text: The visits, lifts and injury figures the industry's end-of-season survey asks for, gathered for you.

items.title: Lift inspection reports for your state
items.text: Your lift checks printed in the layout your state's lift inspectors ask for.

items.title: Visitor forecast
items.text: How busy the next 10 days will be, as a range, from the day of the week, holidays and school breaks, new snow, the weather forecast and the tickets already sold.

items.title: Snow report that writes itself
items.text: Each morning, the day's conditions update for your website, email and social media, written from lifts, trails, grooming and new snow.

items.title: Morning brief for managers
items.text: One short read each morning: yesterday against last year, today's forecast and staffing gaps, lifts on hold, open work orders and open incidents.

items.title: Patrol on the map
items.text: See where patrollers are on the map during a call, and group them into crews for race days and events.

items.title: Hours into your payroll
items.text: Approved hours sent straight to your payroll service instead of a spreadsheet.

items.title: One login for groups of mountains
items.text: Move between mountains you work at without signing in again.

items.title: Connect your other systems
items.text: An API and event notifications for the tools you already use.

items.title: Suggested prices
items.text: Price ideas for busy and quiet days, based on how fast tickets are selling.
